title: plan.html shows only the current slice, with no durable multi-slice roadmap

human_turns.quote: do we currently have a process around backlogging work to return to later? or do I have to remember to re-ask you (since your context can be reset after a slice you may not have a way to resume)
so the fresh agent would be able to understand the full plan with all slices? are all of them stored in plan.html?

So if you were to essentially get a large body of work, scope and break it down, then propose a plan for the first slice, complete that slice, if I was to reset the context. at that point, there would be no understanding or existence of the plan beyond that initial slice. Is that correct?

body:
"Do we currently have a process around backlogging work to return to later?
Or do I have to remember to re-ask you (since your context can be reset after
a slice you may not have a way to resume)" (S20:H9). Then again: "so the
fresh agent would be able to understand the full plan with all slices? are
all of them stored in plan.html?" (S25:H4) and "at that point, there would be
no understanding or existence of the plan beyond that initial slice. Is that
correct?" (S25:H5). Two sessions, five days apart, hit the same missing
mechanism.

**Proposed change** — a durable roadmap artefact (`project.shape.json` is the
closest existing candidate) that survives a context reset across slices,
distinct from the single-slice `proposal.json`.
